q1_issues.issue: The exclusive focus particle "only" is dropped entirely — no (Only ...) atom, so "only one book" and "one book" produce identical parses.

The singular "one book" is encoded as a group with Cardinality 1 rather than the existential witness the singular licenses, so no individual is ever typed (Member sk_book_1 book) and "is there a book on the desk?" cannot bind.

q2_gaps: focus particle on a verbless existential/locative clause — the (Only <filler> <event>) form presupposes an event, and this clause reifies none
static position stated with a preposition other than "in" ("on the desk") — LocatedIn is the only entity-position head offered, so on/in/under collapse
notes: Reading "only one" as "exactly one" and leaving the closure unencoded is licensed by the Cardinality note, but that still does not license dropping the particle where the focus section provides an operator.
